verdict.rationale: Modal says Sandboxes accept custom images with "any dependency" and describes them as a "full, isolated dev environment". It also documents VM Sandboxes (beta), TCP port probes and network controls, so installing and running a headless browser is plausible but only implied. Nothing in the evidence explicitly mentions a headless browser, Chromium/Playwright, or a desktop/VNC environment. Missing for 10: explicit docs or examples of headless browser support, desktop/GUI or VNC streaming capability, and hands-on or community corroboration.
